question: In April 2022, the Prime Minister Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme was extended till December _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme was extended till December **2024**.
 
• PM SVANidhi scheme was launched to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors to help them resume their livelihoods that have been adversely affected due to COVID-19 lockdowns.
 
• The extension of the scheme will allow more vendors to avail the benefits and improve their economic conditions.
 
• Under this scheme, street vendors can avail a working capital loan of up to Rs. 10,000, which is repayable in monthly installments within a year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme also incentivizes regular repayment of loans and digital transactions by vendors.
 
• It aims to formalize the street vendors and open up new opportunities for them to avail benefits of various other government schemes.
 
• Since its launch, the scheme has benefitted numerous street vendors across the country, providing them with much-needed financial support.
 
• The extension till December 2024 will further aid in the economic recovery of street vendors, ensuring their stability and growth.
